email.body1:
Jim, saw Reveal grew its private deployment investment by 50% as enterprise eDiscovery demand surged.

A demand spike like that usually surfaces more in-market accounts than the team can act on, and signal-to-action latency is where pipeline quietly leaks. Our AI SDR turns buying signals into booked meetings with zero rep time per prospect: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new hires.

I built a signal play for Reveal off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jim, quick follow-up for Reveal.

When enterprise demand surges, most RevOps teams have the signals but lose days getting them researched, written, and into a rep's hands, so the window closes first. The measurable lift comes from collapsing that latency, every email auto-logged to your CRM.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three changes I would make. Our best practices alone usually lift reply rates 50-70%.
email.body3:
Jim, last bit of proof for Reveal.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, live in four weeks with every email logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Reveal's reply rate likely compares to peer legal-tech firms. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
